scope: PC virtio RNG PCI probe rejection

cause: Common PCI capability builder advertised a device-specific region of length zero for virtio-rng, which has no such configuration. Linux rejects the region during modern PCI probe.
fix: Omit the device-specific capability for empty configurations and terminate the preceding ISR capability link. Non-empty device configurations retain the existing capability.
